title: Easy Chorizo Stuffing
description: This chorizo stuffing pairs a boxed stuffing mix with fresh chorizo sausage, turning a basic ho-hum stuffing into one with a savory, meaty zest.
ingredients: 1 pound Mexican chorizo sausage, casings removed
1 (6 ounce) package dry bread stuffing mix

steps.text: Combine chorizo, onion, and celery in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir, breaking chorizo up with a spoon until chorizo is browned and crumbly and vegetables are softened, 7 to 9 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl.

Add water to the same skillet; bring to a boil. Add butter to the boiling water and let melt. Stir in stuffing mix, remove from heat, and cover with a lid. Let stand until stuffing mixture has absorbed the liquid, about 5 minutes.
Add chorizo mixture to the stuffing mixture and stir until well combined.
